record_type_quote:
The objective of this article is to assess whether
the gains made in pupil knowledge, self-efficacy
related to sexual restraint and condom use and behaviour change observed in 18- and 30-month
evaluations in Nyanza Province [18, 21] are replicated in diverse regions of the country.

targets.authors: Maticka-Tyndale E, Wildish J, Gichuru M.
targets.title: Testing a national primary school HIV intervention in Kenya.
targets.evidence_quote:
The objective of this article is to assess whether
the gains made in pupil knowledge, self-efficacy
related to sexual restraint and condom use and behaviour change observed in 18- and 30-month
evaluations in Nyanza Province [18, 21] are replicated in diverse regions of the country.
targets.outcome_quote:
This article does provide a response to a limitation
acknowledged in the earlier papers that reported results for only Nyanza Province. The replicability of
that earlier research beyond Nyanza is no longer in
question.
targets.outcome_reasoning: Authors give an overall verdict that the earlier findings replicate beyond Nyanza. This covers both explicitly targeted evaluations despite some less favourable individual outcomes.

reasoning: New cross-sectional samples in five additional regions explicitly test the results of two published Nyanza evaluations. Reference 38 concerns secondary-school sustainability and is not itself the current replication target. Title and authors match; 2013 online publication precedes 2014 issue.
